findings.detail: CAD belongs to the Par field; the three flagged cost units were attributed from the wrong schedule column and should be USD.

rationale: Class 1 review of the three FX03 cells against the raw schedule. Table 8 identifies CAD immediately after maturity in the Par field, while the following values are the separately headed Cost and Fair Value fields. Thus U_CAD is valid for par denomination but not for cost_currency; assigning it to cost is a localized unit/column extraction error. The same structure is visible on the cited rows.
